subject: general
question: In which year did RBI introduce the regulatory framework for microfinance loans?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RBI** introduced the regulatory framework for** microfinance loans** in** February 2022.**
 
• This framework aims to promote responsible lending practices and protect the **interests of borrowers**.
 
• The framework includes guidelines on** interest rates, loan disbursement, repayment,** and **grievance redressal mechanisms.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• RBI stands for **Reserve Bank of India** and is the **central bank **of India.
 
• The Indian government's** Ministry of Finance** is the owner of it.
 
• It is in charge of managing the** Indian rupee's supply,** issuing it, and keeping it in circulation. 
 
• **Microfinance loans** are small loans given to** individuals or groups **who do not have access to traditional banking services.
